设计意图： Mutation targeting improved ICIR and RankICIR by adding a 3-day rolling mean smoothing to the raw drawdown stress factor. Preserves the core tail-risk drawdown/ATR mechanism and the cs_rank post-transform. Smoothing reduces single-day noise while keeping the economic signal intact. Parent strength: tail-risk drawdown capture. Target bottleneck: predictive consistency (ICIR/RankICIR).

max_drawdown(40) / ts_atr(20), sign reversed, smoothed with 3-day moving average
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(fillna(divide((-ts_min(divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjHigh, 40)), ts_max(AdjHigh, 40)), 40)), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20)), ), 3)
  2. 2. fillna —— 缺失值填充
    fillna(divide((-ts_min(divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjHigh, 40)), ts_max(AdjHigh, 40)), 40)), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20)), )
  3. 3. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide((-ts_min(divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjHigh, 40)), ts_max(AdjHigh, 40)), 40)), ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20))
  4. 4. ts_min —— 过去 N 天滚动最小值
    ts_min(divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjHigh, 40)), ts_max(AdjHigh, 40)), 40)
  5. 5. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjHigh, 40)), ts_max(AdjHigh, 40))
  6. 6. subtract —— 减法
    subtract(AdjClose, ts_max(AdjHigh, 40))
  7. 7. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(AdjHigh, 40)
  8. 8. ts_max —— 过去 N 天滚动最大值
    ts_max(AdjHigh, 40)
  9. 9. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean((AdjHigh true_range AdjLow true_range AdjClose), 20)

🔬 陌生算子/字段释义

算子/字段含义
true_range真实波幅 TR = max(H-L, |H-C|, |L-C|)

📝 计算步骤（一步一步解释）

  1. 计算 peak_high：high.滚动窗口(40, min_periods=40).max()
  2. 计算 drawdown：(close - peak_high) / peak_high
  3. 计算 max_drawdown：drawdown.滚动窗口(40, min_periods=40).min()
  4. 计算 atr：talib.ATR(high, low, close, timeperiod=20)
  5. 计算 factor：-max_drawdown / atr
  6. 计算 factor：factor
  7. 计算 factor：factor.滚动窗口(3, min_periods=1).mean()

🐍 原始 Python 代码 (factor_delivery)

"kw">class="kw">def factor_drawdown_stress_smoothed(df): df_copy = df.copy() peak_high = df_copy["str">'high'].rolling(40, min_periods=40).max() drawdown = (df_copy["str">'close'] - peak_high) / peak_high.replace(0, np.nan) max_drawdown = drawdown.rolling(40, min_periods=40).min() atr = talib.ATR(df_copy["str">'high'], df_copy["str">'low'], df_copy["str">'close'], timeperiod=20) factor = -max_drawdown / atr.replace(0, np.nan) factor = factor.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0.0) factor = factor.rolling(3, min_periods=1).mean() df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_stress_smoothed'] = factor "kw">class="kw">return df_copy["str">'factor_drawdown_stress_smoothed']
